decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already captures that commissions are counted only for completed primary mints after mint #1 and excludes secondary sales.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the accepted first-mint exception under which no ticket is awarded when no earlier NFT exists.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records one random commission per no-referral primary mint after mint #1 and that no first-mint random allocation is required.
The accepted exception concerns random allocation when no earlier NFT exists, not ticket issuance for a mint using a valid referral code.
The client expressly treats the first-mint condition as a completed one-off with no forward impact, so the FAQ's ongoing no-referral allocation copy does not necessarily change.
The About-page process copy describes ongoing allocations, while the accepted first-mint exception is explicitly a one-off with no forward impact.
The first-mint ticket-accounting exception does not alter Small Block prize amounts, funding, draw triggers, eligibility windows, or resets.
The metadata requirement remains valid unchanged: only rewards actually credited must be represented, and zero tickets with zero commissions for mint #1 preserves ticket-commission consistency.
The accepted first-mint no-referral exception does not change which referral codes are valid or the validation feedback.
The source decision concerns the absence of an earlier NFT for initial random reward allocation, not VRF selection of prize-draw winners.
The source decision does not alter the badge catalog, badge count, icons, or presentation layout.
The first-mint ticket and commission exception does not change automatic prize delivery or any claim interaction.
